mandatoryCriteria.question: Do display, body and utility typefaces remain within their declared semantic roles?
mandatoryCriteria.failure: Page-local styling or mixed fonts replace the shared hierarchy.

mandatoryCriteria.question: Does every opening paragraph begin at normal body size without a drop cap or oversized initial letter?
mandatoryCriteria.failure: Decorative initial treatment draws more attention than the argument.

mandatoryCriteria.question: Are body size, leading, line length, paragraph spacing and contrast suitable for sustained A4 reading?
mandatoryCriteria.failure: The typography is compressed, overly decorative or dependent on zoom.

mandatoryCriteria.question: Would the meaning remain intact if bold, color and capitalization were removed?
mandatoryCriteria.failure: Styling rather than prose carries the semantic hierarchy.

mandatoryCriteria.question: Do Korean, Latin, punctuation and code glyphs render without fallback-induced hierarchy drift?
mandatoryCriteria.failure: Missing glyphs or inconsistent fallback changes reading rhythm.

decisionRule: Any mandatory typography failure holds the candidate; typography criteria are not averaged with other quality criteria.
